text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #252525

g.text: *Full-use scenarios. Unknown = no adopted same-model quota calibration. All 31 configurations are in the source data.

g.text: Astra/Fable/Kimi retain September community assumptions, not October entitlements. New models do not inherit old quotas.

g.text: GLM: $80 Pro fee, all-off-peak usage; whisker extends to all-peak. The temporary $56 offer is shown separately on the website.

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #252525

g.text: Whiskers are scenarios, not confidence intervals. Using half the assumed monthly usage doubles effective cost per task.
